title: Geometric index theorems for holomorphic foliations and curves
summary: Let $M$ be a complex surface endowed with a holomorphic projective connection and let $C \subset M$ be a compact smooth holomorphic curve. Given two singular holomorphic foliations $\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathcal{G}$ near $C$, with $C$ not $\mathcal{G}$-invariant, we attach to every point $p \in C$ an index $\mathrm{Ind}(\mathcal{F},\mathcal{G},C,p) \in \mathbb{C}$ of $\mathcal{F}$ relative to the reference $\mathcal{G}$, and we prove that these indices add up to $T\mathcal{G} \cdot C$.
